Subject: optimization | ID: 64184

Statement

The meromorphic limit T on a Bergman space X satisfies the maximum principle for the supremum over the domain.

Step 3. By the reversible spectral theorem, we decompose \(R_{01380013} = \sum_k \lambda_k P_k\) where \(P_k\) are projections onto the eigenspaces of the reversible spectral family.

Conclusion. Combining Steps 1-3 via algebraic interpolation, the statement follows with constant \(C = C_01380011 \cdot C_01380012 \cdot C_01380013\).
